title: feat(app-shell,i18n): Home's My work section — approvals first, then notifications, with the pending-drafts row under its heading (objectui#12602)
body:
Fixes #12602
Clause-②: yes

## Summary

The "Needs your attention" card becomes the My work section of the approved home artboard (section ③ of 系统首页 · 四段式). The pending-drafts banner above the greeting moves into it.

- **Heading.** "My work", 15 px / 600, with a count pill: approvals plus unread notification topics, the two numbers the bell badge adds. An "Open inbox" link goes to the inbox route the bell's view-all opens.
- **Drafts row.** A 40 px row on the soft primary tint: a rocket icon, "N unpublished change(s)", the first three draft names, and their package when all drafts share one. Its 28 px Publish button calls the same `usePublishAllDrafts().publishAll` the banner called. The banner is gone from both places it rendered; with no app yet, the row sits where the banner was.
- **Approvals column** (first). It lists the approval requests themselves, titled with the flow label and the record name. The pill, on `--primary`, is the request count from the one shared pending-approvals read the bell and the greeting line use. A row opens the request in the Approvals inbox through its `?request=` deep link; View all opens the Approvals inbox.
- **Notifications column.** The unread inbox preview, newest first. The pill is the bell's `unreadTopicCount`. Targets go through `resolveNotificationTarget`, the bell's own helper.
- **Rows and empty lines.** Up to three 40 px rows per column. A column with nothing reads one muted line, and only once its read has answered. A loading or failed read says so, next to any stale rows.

## The fork: two columns, not three (Target 5)

`sys_inbox_message`, as objectstack declares it at f7e836d, has `topic` (free text), `title`, `severity` (info, warning, critical), `action_url` and `created_at`. It has no declared kind and no due date. So the section ships Approvals / Notifications, and nothing infers "assigned to me", "reminder" or "overdue" from a topic or a title.

The field the three-column form needs is a declared kind on the notification and inbox row (assignment, mention, reminder, system), written by the emitter, plus a due-date datetime for the overdue line. Acceptance 1's "a notification with a past due date reads 逾期" is therefore not implemented. A test pins the opposite: a row whose topic reads like an assignment lands under Notifications, with no overdue text.

## Who sees it

- **Notifications column and Open inbox link:** drawn unless the loaded permissions refuse read on `sys_inbox_message`. Unknown permissions count as readable. This is the predicate the activity card uses for `sys_activity`.
- **Approvals column:** needs a signed-in user. The endpoint answers every signed-in user about their own requests.
- **Whole section:** not drawn when neither column is readable and there are no drafts.

## Measurements: /home at 1280 px, live showcase backend (published @objectstack packages)

| Items | Heading total | Approvals pill / rows | Notifications pill / rows | Bell | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 18 | 18 | 3 / 3 | 15 / 3 | 9+ | Drafts row present: 3 drafts, 40 px. Row height 40 px. Columns 554 px each. Heading 15px/600. Same in light and dark. |
| 2 | 2 | 1 / 1 | 1 / 1 | 2 | Same in light and dark. |
| 0 | no pill | no pill, "Nothing waiting for your approval" | no pill, "No unread notifications" | no badge | Greeting line: "Nothing is waiting for you today". |

Drafts publish, live: with one draft present, a click sent `POST /api/v1/meta/object/ticket/publish` (200), and the row left the page.

## Tests

New pins:
- `HomePage.myWork-12602.test.tsx`: the approvals column is first, the two-column form, the drafts row, and who sees the section.
- `useHomeInbox.myWork-12602.test.tsx`: approval rows deduped per id with count equal to the list length; the readability predicates.
- One new case in `sharedInboxFeed.twoSurfaces.test.tsx`: the approvals column pill equals the bell badge, over the real store and the real bell.

Eight one-time ablations, each red and each restored: count taken from the preview, dedupe removed, approvals column removed, publish made a no-op, drafts row put back above the greeting, hide guard removed, inbox predicate forced true, notice shown only when the column is empty.

Runs:
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/console/home/ packages/app-shell/src/hooks/` at 9bf4170: 177 files, 2066 tests passed.
- The whole of `packages/app-shell/` and `packages/i18n/` at the first commit: 15000 passed, 1 failed. The failure was an i18n pin reading the renamed drafts key, repointed in 9bf4170.

Acceptance 3 names `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` and `pnpm check:i18n`. The first is the package-cwd form AGENTS.md routes to the repo-root vitest invocation, so these runs use that form. The second does not exist; check:i18n-keys, check:i18n-drift and check:i18n-dead-keys all exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `useSharedPendingApprovals` keeps its shape (count plus status). It now reads a feed that holds the request rows, so the count is still the distinct ids from one request.
- The count pills show a count above zero even while a re-read is failing, as the bell does. The empty line waits for an answer.
- The drafts row keeps the banner's gate (a non-zero count from `_drafts`).
- Locale keys added in all ten packs: `home.myWork.*` and `home.pendingDrafts.title` / `inPackage` / `waiting` / `nameSeparator`. Removed: `home.actionCenter.*` and the `home.pendingDrafts.message` family.
- objectui#12604 (HomeContinue, HomeActivity) remains open and is untouched here.
